nodes.label: Finexa Nova app screenshot montage (Dashboard + Debt Portfolio Analysis)
Finexa Nova — investor-facing mobile app, tagline 'Learn, invest and flourish'

Nova app Dashboard screen: goal-tracking cards (e.g. 'Ajay's Education', 'Buying SUV', 'Onkar's Education', 'Start new goal') plus Portfolio Snapshot metrics (Current Value, Holding Cost, IRR, Total Gain/Loss, Realised/Unrealised Gain, Benchmark)

Nova app Debt Portfolio Analysis screen: donut chart of debt sub-asset allocation (Cash, Long Term Debt, Low Duration, Short Term Debt, Debt Others, Hybrid) with matching data table (Current Value, Weight %, Gain/Loss, XIRR)
